text: very DISAPPOINTED liquid chalk Marker DO NOT WORK ON THIS. i was super DISAPPOINTED that this black board does NOT work hardly with liquid chalk markers. don’t get me wrong the packaging was superb and the material is made of is nice quality.  but as soon as I started writing with my liquid chalk marker I was upset. at first i thought maybe it’s the markets so i bought six different kinds and NOPE STILL CRAP.  i am now stuck with a product i can not use and wasted $50 bucks.  THIS SUCKS SO BAD.

product_metadata.title: HBCY Creations Rustic Torched Wood Magnetic Wall Chalkboard, Extra Large Size 20" x 30", Framed Decorative Chalkboard - Great for Kitchen Decor, Weddings, Restaurant Menus and More! … (20" x 30")…
features: BEAUTIFUL DESIGN - This classic rustic wall mounted chalkboard will look great in your home, business, or event. Our chalkboard frames are made with beautiful solid Russian Pine Wood. We've also included a FREE set of chalk and eraser to get you started.
MAGNETIC CHALKBOARD SURFACE - Attach pictures, notes and lists right onto the writing area. All of our framed chalkboards are made with high quality magnetic porcelain steel.
LARGE SIZE - Frame dimensions are 20" x 30" and the writing area is approximately 16" x 26", making this the perfect size for weddings, announcements, home and office use.
DUAL DIRECTION HANGING - The boards comes with inlayed hanging hardware attached for both vertical and horizontal use. We've even included wall anchors, screws and a mini level for your convenience.
THE PERFECT BOARD - Our chalkboard was designed to work perfectly with both chalk markers and traditional chalk. We recommend using HBCY Creations Chalk Markers!

details.Material: Pine Wood and Magnetic Porcelain Steel
